consumer: The frontend map renderer reading snapshot entities.items[] to paint ground items on tiles; it asks 'what items should I DISPLAY at each nearby tile?'
scope: a map region: the ground-item stacks of every nearby tile in the export window/radius around the avatar (not the character's own carried inventory)
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(items) iterates points_in_radius around center, reads map::i_at(p) per tile, and emits each ground item's type_id/name/symbol/pos for the frontend to draw
divergence: A long-handled tool lying on an adjacent tile that the avatar cannot see/reach: a possession or find-item check (Excerpts 2/3, crafting_inventory/charges_of over carried items) returns false, but the map must still DISPLAY the item on that ground tile — an on-person-scoped predicate would wrongly omit it
